answer: beacon folds keys sharing challenge entropy into one vertex and each epoch measures that vertex’s nadir of locked ember across 64 signed blocks; the kth live key is counted only while nadir is at least k² ember locked to that single vertex, forfeited on double-sign. A newcomer holds one key at 1 ember. n co-controlled keys need n² ember piled on one vertex, not n ember spread thin; fresh vertices start at one and cannot pool balance.
